label: The unique-optimum optimizing root is an alternative to WN
note: A narrow being-level one-best-effect variant of WN's optimizing rivals, not Rowe's world-level argument. The conflict with WN is conditional: with SS (85f3fea2) and a rational exercise toward a given being other than the root it makes WN fail (G3 law 3). Refuted conditionally by G1, which does not count (#999: its premises are open). It is not WN's decisive rival: the selective-diffusion and world-level-optimizer rivals are recorded beside it, unrefuted.
